notes: v1.2.1: Play button fixed for real. The player now has a watchdog: if the audio engine's clock is frozen a second after you tap Play (the Android WebView bug where the context says 'running' but time never advances), it throws that broken engine away, builds a fresh one and retries the play once — and if that still fails it tells you the exact engine state instead of spinning silently. Songs no longer auto-play after Create (that ran outside your tap, so Android blocked it); you tap Play yourself. The song sheet now shows a live 'Audio: running, time X.XXs' readout so you can report the exact state, the Library header shows the app version, and the update check also reads www/version.json on main so it spots a new version even when the release title has no version in it.
